# grafana_oncall_team_hours (Resource)

Manages the team hours of a Grafana IRM (OnCall) team.

A team has up to three named intervals, each with up to three time ranges per weekday. The team is within its hours when the current time falls in any range of any interval. Use them with the `pause_until_team_hours` step of the `grafana_oncall_escalation` resource.

Times are read in the team's timezone, which cannot be set with this resource: it is set in **IRM** > **Settings** > **Teams** and defaults to UTC.

Destroying this resource removes all of the team's intervals, so IRM treats the team as always within its hours.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grafana_team" "example" {
  name = "Example team"
}

data "grafana_oncall_team" "example" {
  name       = grafana_team.example.name
  depends_on = [grafana_team.example]
}

// Up to three named intervals. The team is in hours when the current time is in any range of any interval.
// Times are read in the team's timezone (set in IRM > Settings > Teams, UTC by default).
resource "grafana_oncall_team_hours" "example" {
  team_id = data.grafana_oncall_team.example.id

  interval {
    name = "Business hours"
    monday {
      start = "09:00"
      end   = "12:00"
    }
    monday {
      start = "13:00"
      end   = "17:00"
    }
    tuesday {
      start = "09:00"
      end   = "17:00"
    }
    wednesday {
      start = "09:00"
      end   = "17:00"
    }
    thursday {
      start = "09:00"
      end   = "17:00"
    }
    friday {
      start = "09:00"
      end   = "17:00"
    }
  }

  interval {
    name = "Weekend coverage"
    saturday {
      start = "10:00"
      end   = "14:00"
    }
  }
}

// Hold escalation until the team is in its hours
resource "grafana_oncall_escalation_chain" "example" {
  name = "Example chain"
}

resource "grafana_oncall_escalation" "wait_for_team_hours" {
  escalation_chain_id    = grafana_oncall_escalation_chain.example.id
  type                   = "pause_until_team_hours"
  notify_to_team_members = data.grafana_oncall_team.example.id
  position               = 0
  depends_on             = [grafana_oncall_team_hours.example]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) The ID of the OnCall team, for example from the `grafana_oncall_team` data source.

### Optional

- `interval` (Block List) A named set of weekly hours. Up to three. Each needs at least one time range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `timezone` (String) The team's timezone, as set in IRM. Empty when unset, in which case UTC is used.

<a id="nestedblock--interval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interval`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the interval, up to 100 characters.

Optional:

- `friday` (Block List) A time range on Friday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--friday))
- `monday` (Block List) A time range on Monday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--monday))
- `saturday` (Block List) A time range on Saturday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--saturday))
- `sunday` (Block List) A time range on Sunday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--sunday))
- `thursday` (Block List) A time range on Thursday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--thursday))
- `tuesday` (Block List) A time range on Tuesday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--tuesday))
- `wednesday` (Block List) A time range on Wednesday. Up to three, in start-time order and not overlapping. Omit the block to make the day a day off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--interval--wednesday))

<a id="nestedblock--interval--friday"></a>
### Nested Schema for `interval.friday`

Required:

- `end` (String) End time as `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`, in the team's timezone. Must be after `start`; to end at midnight use `23:59:59`.
- `start` (String) Start time as `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`, in the team's timezone.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import grafana_oncall_team_hours.name "{{ id }}"
```
